items.title: Evercore explains why Apple has the right assets to win the personal agents race
items.summary: Investing.com -- Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) has the technology, user base, and payment infrastructure to become a leading player in personal AI agents, potentially generating billions in new revenue, according to Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani.

items.title: Italy fines Meta $880 mn over photo privacy: authority
items.summary: Italian regulators fined Facebook parent company Meta 805 million euros ($880 million) for accessing users' photos without their "specific" consent, the country's data protection authority said on Saturday.Through the Facebook application for Android devices, Meta accessed photographs, videos and related metadata belonging to Italian users "without obtaining specific consent and without properly informing them", the authority said in a statement.

items.title: Italy fines Meta $880 million over accessing users' photos
items.summary: The country's data protection authority said Meta accessed users' photos without their "specific" consent.

items.title: Italy fines Meta €805 million over access to Android users’ photos
items.summary: Investing.com -- Italy's data protection authority has fined Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META) €805 million ($887 million) after finding that the company accessed photographs and videos stored on Android users' devices without obtaining their permission or adequately informing them.

items.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Says There’s a Huge Disconnect in Wall Street’s Expectations for Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Alphabet
items.summary: Wall Street expects the hyperscalers to keep up their heavy capital expenditures, but it's worried that the revenue growth they are expecting to result from that spending might not show up.

items.title: Meta Is Testing a Prediction-Market App With Its Employees
items.summary: Meta employees are betting fake points on Jeopardy! winners inside a secret app that has already worn three names. Can a free game succeed where the company's 2020 attempt failed, and why would an ad giant want it?

items.title: SpaceX Hollows Out Its AI Video Division. Elon Musk Now Has Different Priorities
items.summary: A quiet round of layoffs just gutted one of Elon Musk's flashiest AI products, months after he vowed to double down on it. The retreat could hand a rival with deep pockets and a giant video platform exactly the opening it needs.

items.title: Jamie Dimon Just Said 5 Words Blocking Outside AI Agents From JPMorgan Accounts: "You Don't Want Rogue Agents." Here's Why That Security Stance Matters for JPM and Its Tech Rivals.
items.summary: The CEO of JPMorgan Chase isn't going to open his customers' accounts to "just any" AI agents from third parties.
